name: Browser takeover for Google setup
author: wizard
description: Your box's agent gets Human Handoff (hermes-human-handoff v0.1.0 with Python Playwright): it opens a fresh, throwaway browser on the box and sends you a private link to it on your phone, so you sign in to Google yourself and it does the rest of Connected accounts' Google app setup. The App Manager (wam/human_handoff.py) installs it within the hour, and removes it when you turn this off. Nothing on screen changes.
